agentRecommendations.title: Video content is the weakest MVP signal
agentRecommendations.desc: Only 3 of 100 target videos published. Start an Azure AI Foundry playlist immediately — video is the fastest community growth lever.

agentRecommendations.title: Blog velocity needs to reach 8 posts/month
agentRecommendations.desc: At ~2/month the projected total by Aug 2027 is 38. Need to 4× cadence by Q1 to have any chance of hitting 100.

agentRecommendations.title: AI Engineering coverage is solid
agentRecommendations.desc: The Field Notes series (50+ queued issues) is strong, credible evidence of practical depth — exactly what nomination reviewers look for.

growthPlaybook.label: LinkedIn Network
growthPlaybook.weeklyAction: Write a LinkedIn post summarising the ADLC methodology — link the blog, share 3 key takeaways, tag 2–3 AI engineers for their view.
tactics: Post 3× per week: 1 technical insight, 1 platform update, 1 open question to the community
Comment meaningfully on 5–10 posts/day in Azure AI, GitHub Copilot, and AI Engineering feeds
Share every new blog post as a short native text post with 3 key takeaways and a link
Use consistent hashtags: #AzureAI #GitHubCopilot #AgenticAI #AIEngineering #MicrosoftMVP
Tag Microsoft or GitHub when you share their tools — increases reach significantly
Post a weekly 'TIL' (Today I Learned) about something from your exam or blog work
Engage with Microsoft MVPs and Developer Advocates — they amplify community content

growthPlaybook.label: Video Content
growthPlaybook.weeklyAction: Record a 5-minute Azure AI Foundry 'Getting Started' screen-capture — no editing needed, just narrate as you go.
tactics: Start with screen-capture walkthroughs — no camera, just narrate what you build
One playlist per domain: Azure AI Foundry, GitHub Copilot, Agentic AI, AI Architecture
Repurpose each blog post into a 3-minute explainer video
YouTube Shorts (< 60 sec) for single tips — e.g., 'What is ADLC in 45 seconds'
Link every video in the corresponding blog post and exam notes page
Cross-post YouTube links on LinkedIn — video posts get 3× the organic reach of text
Batch-record 3–4 videos per session to maintain cadence without daily effort

growthPlaybook.label: Blog Posts
growthPlaybook.weeklyAction: Publish one post from the Field Notes backlog (#229, #230, #231) — they are already scoped, just write.
tactics: Target 2 posts/week minimum — 1 deep technical, 1 shorter field note or TIL
Turn every exam study session into a blog post: 'What I learned from CCA-F domain X'
Repurpose architecture diagrams into standalone explainer posts
Write a 'Week in AI' digest post each Friday — low effort, high cadence signal
Cross-post to Dev.to and Hashnode with canonical URL pointing to aaryaai.dev
Submit to Azure Friday newsletter or Microsoft Tech Community blog
Each post should link to a related exam track — drives study traffic

growthPlaybook.label: Speaking Sessions
growthPlaybook.weeklyAction: Submit one CFP to a Global AI Community or Azure User Group event — CFPs take 15 minutes, close many weeks out.
tactics: Track CFP deadlines: Global AI Community, AI Summit, Microsoft AI Tour, Local Azure UGs
Start with virtual events — lower barrier, wider audience, recorded for YouTube
Repurpose a blog post as a 20-minute talk: ADLC, AI Architecture Blueprint, Agentic AI
Offer to co-present with a Microsoft MVP or Developer Advocate for instant credibility
Lightning talks (5–10 min) count toward nomination — target local meetups first
Record every talk and upload to YouTube — doubles the evidence for your nomination
Submit to Microsoft Reactor community speakers programme

growthPlaybook.label: Community Members
growthPlaybook.weeklyAction: Enable GitHub Discussions on this repo and post a welcome thread linking to the platform.
tactics: Launch GitHub Discussions as the primary community space — zero infrastructure cost
Create a monthly 'AI Architecture Review' thread where members share designs
Pin a 'Start here' post that links to exam tracks, blog, and how to contribute
Announce each new blog/video on LinkedIn with a CTA to join the community
Host a monthly 30-minute virtual office hours session — record and post
Create a 'Study Group' channel for each exam — peer accountability drives retention
Register on ADPList to attract mentees who become community members

growthPlaybook.label: GitHub Stars
growthPlaybook.weeklyAction: Add a '⭐ Star this repo' CTA at the end of every blog post and in the platform footer.
tactics: Add a 'Star on GitHub' button to the platform homepage and every blog post
Share the repo link when posting on LinkedIn, Dev.to, Hashnode, and Reddit r/MachineLearning
Submit to awesome-* lists: awesome-azure-ai, awesome-github-copilot, etc.
Post a 'What I built' repo showcase on LinkedIn every 2 weeks
Engage in GitHub Discussions on related repos — your profile links back to this repo
Add the repo to your LinkedIn featured section and GitHub profile README

growthPlaybook.label: Mentoring Sessions
growthPlaybook.weeklyAction: Register on ADPList (adplist.org) — profile takes 10 minutes, first booking usually comes within a week.
tactics: Register on ADPList — largest free mentoring platform for tech professionals
Offer 30-minute 'AI Career Clarity' sessions: how to pivot into AI engineering
Post 'DM me for a free AI architecture review' on LinkedIn once a month
Add a 'Book a session' link to your LinkedIn profile and the platform About page
Mentor students preparing for AI-900, AI-102, or GitHub Copilot certifications
Each session = MVP evidence — log date, topic, outcome in a private note
